rule: Each call in a multi-line method chain is reported on the line of its own method name, not the chain's first line.
notes: call_type convention (SPEC gives no Elixir mapping; Elixir has no methods and the `macro` type is defined only for C/C++/ObjC and Rust `name!`): every local, imported and remote call is direct, a call through a value is callback. Operators and special forms (`|>`, `=`, `case`, `fn`, `%{}`, `__MODULE__`) are language constructs, not calls. The pipeline starts on line 3 (`text`); each stage's call is on its own line. `&String.trim/1` is a capture, not a call. `keep?(s)` is inside an anonymous fn passed as an argument: it folds into `MyApp.Pipe.process`.
